compiled_state.description:
## Summary
All legacy feature flags identified and removed (or migrated to config keys). flag-mint pathway checks for written deprecation plan before creating new flags.

## Done Definitions
- All legacy flags identified and removed (or migrated to config keys)
- flag-mint pathway checks for deprecation plan before creating new flag
- Negative test: flag-mint without deprecation plan is refused
- Positive test: flag-mint with written deprecation plan containing [plan_date, owner, replacement_key] succeeds and creates the flag

## SC Coverage
SC7

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
